jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.desc:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 
 What you will do 

 Service Operations & Technology (SO&T) is the engine behind customer uptime and service growth within the Volvo Group. As part of Truck Technology & Industrial (TTI), we bring together uptime & service technology, purchasing, logistics and remanufacturing into one global end-to-end organization. 

 Within SO&T, Reman+ has more than 80 years of expertise in delivering high-quality remanufactured products that extend the lifetime of vehicles and machines while supporting the circular economy. With production sites across Europe, North and South America, India and China, we serve customers worldwide through a competitive global remanufacturing network. 

 The China site produces remanufactured engines, hydraulics and other service market products, with the potential to grow product and business portfolio by supporting the Asia-Pacific region.

 We are looking for a passionate and experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join our growing Reman+ team and play a key role in building new remanufacturing operations, from product industrialization to manufacturing process development.

 As a Manufacturing Engineer, Engine Remanufacturing, you will be part of the engineering team that supports production with technical solutions for production processes, equipment and layout, as well as implementation of new products and product design changes related to engine products.   

 Key Responsibilities:  

• Support the local production site and be the connection with Product Development and Pilot Plants in product/design related questions and changes. 

• Design, develop, and implement new or revised remanufacturing processes for the cost-efficient reman/refurbish products. 

• Design and set requirements for manufacturing equipment and tools. 

• Design and optimize factory layout set-up. 

• Develop and maintain work instructions for production teams. 

• Lead or participate in new product industrialization projects. 

• Management of BOMs and Design Change Notifications. 

• Lead and coordinate maintenance activities. 

• Participate in pre-study projects of new remanufactured products and manufacturing technologies. 

• Support the production team for technical related matters. 

• Support Quality cases when needed. 

• Closely work and collaborate with global engineering and logistics teams in France/Sweden/China. 

 Who are you? 

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Mechatronics or a related Engineering field.   

• At least 5 years of experience in Manufacturing engineering or a related role, preferred in powertrain systems (Engine, Transmission, Hydraulics...etc) industries.   

• Experience in green field plant/production line is an advantage.   

• Experience in aftermarket service, reman or technical training is an advantage.   

• Skilled in CAD tools.   

• Knowledge of safety procedures.   

• Understand the reman technology framework and trend, is a plus.   

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.   

• Project management experience and  ability to work cross-functionally.   

• Strong communication and presentation skills.   

• Fluent in English and Chinese, in speaking and writing.   

• Open to occasional overseas business trips.   

 We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 

 Who we are and what we believe in  
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

 Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group . Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 

 Trucks Technology & Industrial Division  hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. 
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer I - Assembly & Integration
jobs.desc:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB 

 Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

 MANUFACTURING 

 Manufacturing Engineering powers Rocket Lab’s factories from concept to full-scale production. We turn early ideas into manufacturable designs, build and optimize the systems that make them real, and constantly push for faster, better, smarter ways to build. We engineer the factories that build the rockets, boosting quality, cutting cost, and accelerating build rate. 

 SENIOR MANUFACTURING ENGINEER I - ASSEMBLY & INTEGRATION 

 This role focuses on improving manufacturing processes by conducting feasibility studies, supporting product design for manufacturability, and leading factory setup and optimization. It involves troubleshooting production issues, collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving process improvements, and supporting organizational efficiency through effective change management and business system enhancements.

 WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO: 

• Prepare feasibility studies and conduct manufacturing technology Research & Development projects  

• Partner with our Design Engineering teams to incorporate Design for Manufacture into our products to ensure robustness and manufacturability at scale  

• Engineer and deliver our factories – design, procure, install, validate assembly, test and verification processes  

• Support Development builds to uncover early learnings and resolve issues to accelerate the production ramp up  

• Take engineering ownership of production lines to remove blockers, improve yield and increase build efficiency  

• Triage and diagnose failures, conduct deep technical investigations and determine the right path forward including risk mitigation actions and root cause resolution  

• Collaborate with cross functional teams to resolve complex issues  

• Drive process improvements across manufacturing, test and integration  

• Contribute to change management, assessing risk and impact of design or process changes  

• Support business system and process improvements to drive increased organizational effectiveness and efficiency  

 YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS: 

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or similar  

• 5+ years of technical experience in a Manufacturing, Production, or Process Engineering environment 

• Hands-on experience proactively identifying and solving systemic multifaceted problems in complex manufacturing systems

• Ability to effectively deliver on multiple complex multifaceted assignments simultaneously with autonomy

• Ability to effectively coach and mentor others to raise the bar across multiple teams 

• Detailed technical knowledge in complex manufacturing processes

 THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE: 

• Working experience with environmental acceptance/production acceptance testing, such as vibration, shock, thermal, and vacuum 

• Understanding of instrumentation, interfaces, and sensors including power supplies, oscilloscopes, serial devices, switch topologies, accelerometers, thermocouples, RTDs, and 4-20mA sensors 

• Experience with designing, implementing, and supporting a production line and/or build area 

• Experience transitioning products from design to production as a part of cross-functional team in a fast-paced, iterative design environment 

• Demonstrated experience with DFMEA, PFMEA methodologies, Fault Tree Analysis, Pareto analysis, root cause and corrective action

• Ability to effectively deliver on complex assignments with autonomy 

 This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas. 

 Anticipated annual equity grant value is designed around function, level, experience, and other factors; realized value depends on vesting and stock-price performance. 

 Join one of the world's fastest-growing space companies and own a piece of it. In addition to competitive base pay, you'll receive company stock as part of your total compensation package , giving you a direct stake in our success. As we expand to new launch sites, groundbreaking missions, and global markets, your ownership has the opportunity to grow alongside the company. 

 Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match. 

 Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts. 

 Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

 Base Salary

 We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all task

jobs.title: Sr. IC Package Design Engineer (Silicon Engineering)
jobs.desc:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 SR. IC PACKAGE DESIGN ENGINEER (SILICON ENGINEERING) 

 At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. 

 We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. As an IC Package Design Engineer, you will be an integral part of the IC design team and lead packaging for custom in-house ASICs and RFICs for digital beam formers and modems. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

• Own and drive advanced package selection, new product BGA configuration and package structure

• Responsible for package/SIP layout, optimization, design verification and tapeout

• Interface and coordinate with cross-functional groups throughout SpaceX on new product package selection, feasibility analysis and design

• Work cross-functionally, understand trade-offs, constraints, and optimizing silicon floor plan, bump and package pin out

• Simulate and optimize signal/power integrity and RF performance of the package design

• Drive methodology, innovations, and productivity improvements in package design

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or physics

• 5+ years of experience with IC package design

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

• Experience with Co-packaged Optics (CPO)

• Thorough understanding of signal and power integrity fundamentals

• Substrate design experience for RF, digital, high-speed and mixed signal die

• Experience with Cadence APD+/SIP or similar design tools

• Experience in package design electrical review, SI/PI analysis

• Fluent in SI/PI and EM simulation tools such as SIWave, HFSS, ADS

• Experience in package design for manufacturing reviews

• Familiar with BGA package substrate technologies

• Strong problem solving skills with strong engineering fundamentals

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 

• Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed to meet mission critical deadlines

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS: 

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.  At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

 Raytheon brings the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. We deliver solutions that help our nation and allies defend freedom and deter aggression, creating a safer, more secure world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

 Raytheon is seeking a Senior Manufacturing Process Engineer. The Manufacturing Process Engineering team performs hands-on problem solving in a collaborative and fast-paced manufacturing environment. We are subject matter experts for processes in cleanroom and non-cleanroom environments which focus on radiofrequency (RF) microelectronic component assembly. This hands-on role confronts new projects and challenges every day and requires cross-functional collaboration in both cutting-edge automation and mature production processes. The Engineer develop and implement materials and process improvements to our factory, while providing production support using a variety of analytical techniques, including statistical process control, predictive equipment maintenance, material analysis, and root cause analysis. We perform the evaluation of materials, equipment, and processes (including qualification, acceptance testing, and specification development) and interface with key internal and external suppliers to resolve technical issues. We are specifically seeking candidates who are hands-on, enjoy diving deep into technical requirements, proactive, accountable, good communicators, adaptable in a fast-paced environment, experienced in automated manufacturing, and ready to solve unique problems daily.

 What You Will Do 

 • Supports the RF Radiator, Circulator, and Lids factory in high-volume, high-mix production with on-site responsiveness to equipment, process, material, and product problems

• Work hand-in-hand with product engineers, quality engineers, reliability engineers, and manufacturing engineers on product manufacturing
• Develop and implement materials, processes, process improvements, and production support using established statistical process control techniques, experimental designs, material analysis, mechanical design analysis, and root cause analysis
• This role will require you to be onsite in our McKinney, TX facility and spend 8+ hours per day in a clean room environment, following clean room and electrostatic discharge (ESD) procedures
• This role is for a day shift (start time range: 6 AM - 8 AM) with potential for 9/80 schedule. Flexibility in starting times may be required based on production demand as this is a high volume 24/7 operation

 Qualifications You Must Have 

 • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience unless prohibited by local laws/regulations
• Experience with automated machines and processes in RF microelectronics, including screen printing, epoxy dispensing, curing operations, and surface mount technology (SMT)
• Experience navigating technical requirements within military and industry standards and other engineering data packages (i.e. product drawings)
• Experience in Statistical Process Control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA)
• Experience in manufacturing with surface mount technology (SMT), microelectronics, and/or automated assembly equipment

 Qualifications We Prefer 

 • Knowledge of J-STD-001, MIL-STD-883, MIL-PRF-38534, AS9100and IPC standards
• Experience with MRSI, Kurtz Ersa, Palomar, Hesse, or other similar equipment
• Proven track record of root cause and corrective action (RCCA) project completion
• Experience in process development and qualification

 What We Offer

jobs.title: Lead Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.desc:
Help shape the future of mobility!

 At Aptiv, we envision a future with zero road injuries or fatalities. To help us get there ,  active safety  plays a crucial role by preventing the accident altogether. 
 Aptiv's Next-Gen ADAS platform is the foundation for advanced active safety, and sophisticated radars provide the sensor input that make that foundation even more robust.  

 Your Role  

 • Lead the industrialization of new radar and electronics products from business award through serial production (SOP).
• Act as the primary manufacturing interface between Product Design, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Production Plants.
• Drive DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) reviews to ensure products can be built robustly and efficiently.
• Create and maintain manufacturing project plans, launch timing, industrialization deliverables, and milestone tracking.
• Lead MSD workshops, process flow development, and manufacturing readiness reviews.
• Develop production line concepts including equipment selection, material flow, cycle time analysis, traceability, and automation strategies.
• Drive PFMEA, manufacturing risk assessments, process validation, and capability studies (Cp/Cpk).
• Define equipment requirements, manage RFQs/SOWs, support supplier selection, and oversee equipment buy-offs.
• Support prototype, DV, PV, and customer builds while ensuring lessons learned are incorporated into future launches.
• Escalate technical, timing, quality, and cost risks and drive recovery actions to protect SOP commitments.

 Your Background  

 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field.
• Demonstrated ability to transform product designs into robust, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing solutions.
• Strong knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, and Production Validation processes.
• Experience working with automotive standards such as IATF 16949, VDA, customer-specific requirements.
• Hands-on experience with manufacturing processes including SMT, assembly automation, test systems, traceability, and process validation.
• Ability to interpret drawings, GD&T requirements, technical specifications, DFMEA outputs, and design documentation.
• Strong project management skills with experience leading cross-functional industrialization and launch activities.
• Proven problem-solving capability using methodologies such as 8D, A3, Root Cause Analysis, DMAIC, or similar structured approaches.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills in a global environment, including customer-facing technical discussions.
• Self-driven, proactive, and results-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset and working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles.

Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

We are seeking a Components Manufacturing Engineer who will be responsible for establishing, developing, and scaling advanced manufacturing processes for critical hardware. You’ll take full ownership of component fabrication from concept through production, driving design-for-manufacture, process development, and continuous improvement, this includes valves, fluids components, actuators,  manifolds, and electro-mechanical assemblies.

You’ll work closely with design, materials, and production teams to bridge the gap between prototype and production, helping define what world-class manufacturing looks like for our next-generation hardware.

• Able to start full time in 2027.

• Material Flow - designing how material flow around a facility, pull systems, Kanban, Min/ max calculations, Part presentation to operator, Tote bin packaging, lineside racking.

• Prior knowledge and interaction with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for production operations

Job Description: 
 En quête d’une première expérience qui fait la différence ?  
 Rejoins Airbus Atlantic et donne une trajectoire unique à ton parcours grâce à ce stage.  

 Nous sommes un leader mondial sur le marché des aérostructures, des sièges pilotes et des fauteuils passagers premium. 
 Dans le cadre de votre formation initiale, vous recherchez un stage obligatoire ou intégré dans une année de césure, d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, vous permettant de valider votre année.

 Une offre de stage intitulée « STAGE 2027 - Gestion de projet IA et Qualité Industrialisation (ALL GENDER) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’Airbus Atlantic sur le site de Montoir de Bretagne.

 Retrouvez Airbus Atlantic en vidéo  et la Présentation du site de Montoir de Bretagne

 Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 15 personnes au sein du département Qualité en charge de l'industrialisation des modifications importantes et des nouveaux produits.

 • Projets d'industrialisation de nouveaux produits, de modifications majeurs, de nouvelles infrastructures pour accompagner les montées en cadence 
• Assurance qualité du métier "Manufacturing Engineering" visant la réalisation des dossiers industriels bon du premier coup

 Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau BAC+5 dans le domaine informatique, production. Le domaine IA est un axe important de développement pour vous et dans vos études.

 Vous avez les connaissances et compétences suivantes :  

 • Maitrise de l'environnement Google et de GEMINI, capable de générer des scripts sous Python 
• Savoir être : Curiosité, Esprit d'équipe, Bonne communication, Capacité d'adaptation 

 Langues : 
 • Anglais  :  intermédiaire 
• Français : courant 
 Vous pourrez être amené(e) à vous déplacer avec votre tuteur.

 Rejoindre Airbus Atlantic en tant que stagiaire, c'est :

• Acquérir des compétences dans un environnement dynamique qui encourage la créativité et l'initiative, avec une approche entrepreneuriale,
• Évoluer au sein d'une organisation solidaire, qui valorise la proximité et l'humain.

 Toutes les candidatures seront soigneusement examinées par un recruteur.

Job Description 

 Producibility Engineer (Component Design Engineer) – Controls Lifecycle Engineering 
 Full Time 
 Solihull/Derby – Hybrid 

 Why join Rolls-Royce? 

 At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

 By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

 As a Producibility / Component Design Engineer in the Engineering Delivery Team you will be part of a team at the forefront of Rolls-Royce’s drive to establish World Class Technical Response.  Focused primarily on Control System Units you will be delivering Minor Design Changes and Design Engineering Support for both Original Equipment (OE) and Maintenance Repair and Overhaul (MRO) Operations.

 You will be responsible for the on-time delivery and quality of component design definitions that meet system level and sub-system requirements.   You will participate within a cross functional Integrated Project Team (ITP) and operate in accordance with applicable Rolls-Royce Management System (RRMS) policies and processes.  You will be responsible for sub-system integration of the technical activities for their design solutions and enabling lifecycle profitability through the Supply Chain Design.

 What you will be doing: 

 As the Producibility Engineer, you will be accountable for:
 • Delivery of design solutions for component(s) and complex unit assemblies whilst considering Safety, Manufacturing Capability, Product Physical and Functional Robustness, Unit Cost, Lifecycle Cost, Weight, Maintainability, Repair.
• Delivery of definition to appropriate stakeholder groups’ requirements (e.g. manufacturing (domestic/external), project customers, airframers and partners, analysis team etc).
• Creation and use of automated and integrated tool sets. When repeat design is anticipated, create automated workflows to enable the design of the component utilising house style, standard features, and standard assessments to define the optimum design as part of automated MBD, manufacture and measurement definitions.
• Elimination of non-conformance and delivery of Zero Defects/Producibility within the Operations Environment through analysis of customer and programme requirements and incorporation of manufacturing and measurement process capability into the design solution.  Adoption of lean principles such as standardisation/house style to achieve deterministic solutions and producible components in a repeatable fashion. Improvements to design methods, rules and tools to achieve robustness. Application of Robust Design, Systems Engineering, Risk Management (xFMEA) and Design in Context to ensure right first time can be achieved.
• Quality Assurance through checking of design documents, models, drawings in accordance with RRMS technical requirements and proactive Zero Defects approaches.
• Carry out analyses using formula-based calculations and/or automated workflows for dimensioning of parts and components (e.g. stability, stiffness, profiles, balance point, weights) and where appropriate, using analytical rules, tools and methods to underwrite the design solution against requirements.
• Create technical documents to comply with process, knowledge management, information and data policies.
• Enable through life Supply Chain Design and Lifecycle profitability for mature product fleets through the application non-conformance management, drawing alteration requests, repair instructions, engine manual limits and Technical Variances (TV).
• Plan, manage and execute external designs via orders placed at design service providers or suppliers with design and production authorisation for complete devices (Design only / Design and Make Package) leading to approval of the designs and all documents.
• Manage product configuration and assure data integrity.
• Execute sub-system integration process including the appropriate use of Systems Engineering and Robust Design tools to ensure that the technical attributes of the Sub-system design meet the agreed requirements.

 Preferred requirements: 

 • Bachelor's degree or Master's in Engineering or regional equivalent qualification, or equivalent experience
• Strong technical knowledge in mechanical design methodologies and understand cross-discipline engineering concepts which include but are not limited to manufacturing engineering, aerodynamics, thermodynamics, thermal and mechanical analysis, cost engineering and product definition.
• An ability to apply logical, analytical and innovative thinking on a range of technical problems and make balanced decisions across technical and business parameters
• Knowledge and experience of product integrity / liability and certification frameworks
• Membership of a relevant professional body appropriate to region. In the UK - attained/ working towards Chartered status is preferred (and equivalent regional variations)
• Good communication and presentation skills at all levels of the organisation

   Benefits will include: 

 • Retirement Savings through the Rolls-Royce Retirement Savings Trust
• Group Life Assurance provides for a lump sum benefit if you die whilst employed by Rolls-Royce
• Group Income Protection provides an income in the event that you are unable to work due to illness or injury
• Your Shares: Matched is a simple way to own Rolls-Royce shares and invest in our future, together. Buy one share, get one free!
• Digital GP provides a convenient way for you to access GP consultations
• Employee Assistance (EAP) and Live Well programmes

Job Description 

 Manufacturing Engineer – Casting Technical Specialist 
 Ansty 
 Onsite 
 Staff 

 Why join Rolls-Royce?
 At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. 
 By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

 As an Engineer based at the High Temperature Research Centre (HTRC) in Ansty, you will conduct research and improvement activities related to the design and manufacture of turbine components.  The HTRC is a collaboration between the University of Birmingham and Rolls-Royce and is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment for investment casting, machining and advanced metrology of single crystal components.  This role has a focus on technical specialism of the single crystal investment casting process.

 What you will be doing: 

 • Manufacturing Engineers are primarily accountable for the equipment and process methods used with the HTRC. 
• They drive best practice and continuous improvement into their process area whilst acting as a central point for knowledge management and communication across the HTRC and externally with suppliers, customers and partners. 
• They play a key role in supporting and liaising with the operational teams ensuring safe and reliable equipment and processes. 
• Responsible for building and maintaining links with engineering teams within domestic Rolls-Royce foundries in order to scope projects to be carried out within HTRC to support continuous improvement.

 Position requirements: 

 • Degree qualified
• Strong fundamental understanding of single crystal investment casting manufacturing capability
• Demonstrate technical capability based on practical knowledge and experience
• Sound understanding of manufacturing engineering and component engineering principles
• Demonstrate technical knowledge of turbine components and/or process knowledge associated with investment casting
• Be equipped with a strong functional skill set (problem solving, programme management, change control, risk management and budgetary control)

 Preferred requirements: 

 • Experience working in research and/or production manufacturing environments
• Created and managed complex experiments to understand and develop manufacturing and component capability
• Created, managed and approved methods of manufacture and technical packages allowing component manufacture and delivery
• Acted to continuously improve current manufacturing methods and developed novel manufacturing capability for turbines component manufacture
• Influenced the creation and deployment of future manufacturing capability roadmaps to ensure world class processes are operated
• Understood equipment requirements, developed equipment capability, installed and validated new manufacturing equipment
• Ensured stability and reliability of process equipment and process methods
• Developed and coached Technicians and Engineers in manufacturing processes
• Benchmarked external capability

 Regional Benefits: 

 • Work in a safety-first environment were doing the right thing and keeping it simple are core principles.
• Join a culture that values making a real difference through your work.
• Develop your career as a mid-career professional blending technical expertise with strong personal qualities.
• Thrive in a role that encourages integrity, accountability, resilience, and curiosity.

• Take initiative, lead, and make smart decisions with confidence and support.
• Grow through continuous learning, openness to improvement, and exposure to challenging opportunities.

 Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

 Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

ASIC / FPGA Digital Design Engineer – (Associate or Experienced) 

 Company: 

 Boeing Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems has an exciting opportunity for multiple ASIC/ FPGA Digital Design Engineers – (Associate or Experienced) to join us as part of our Boeing Electronic Products team at the heart of Boeing’s products to support advanced digital subsystem development in an aerospace environment in El Segundo or Huntington Beach, CA.  

Engineers may support ASIC, FPGA, or mixed ASIC/FPGA developments depending on program assignment, technical specialization, and organizational needs. Work may include requirements development and capture, architecture support, HDL development, simulation, synthesis, FPGA implementation, timing analysis, integration, troubleshooting, verification collaboration, and traceability activities depending on role level and assignment scope.

 Programs, Products, & Growth Opportunities 

Engineers contribute to advanced aerospace and defense programs spanning space, aviation, communications, and autonomous systems. Programs may include next-generation satellite and space systems, modules supporting NASA missions, Space Launch System (SLS)-related technologies, commercial and military aircraft platforms, autonomous aviation technologies, and emerging digital architectures supporting future aerospace systems.

Engineers support a broad portfolio spanning ASICs, SoCs, and FPGAs across multiple concurrent aerospace and defense programs. Collaborations within the broader organization include space and satellite efforts, commercial and military aviation programs, and autonomous aviation initiatives involving organizations such as Millennium Space Systems and Wisk Aero.

Department expertise spans requirements development, architecture activities, RTL design, ASIC development, FPGA implementation, timing analysis, verification collaboration, integration support, and system-level troubleshooting.

Engineers have opportunities to broaden across conceptual architecture, requirements development, HDL ownership, FPGA implementation, timing analysis, verification collaboration, subsystem development, and integration activities while deepening selected technical specialties over time. The organization intentionally supports growth from focused contributors toward broader technical ownership, subsystem responsibilities, mentorship, and technical leadership roles as experience develops.

Teams are intentionally composed of engineers with complementary strengths spanning architecture, implementation, verification, integration, timing, and troubleshooting. The role is not intended to imply that every engineer must simultaneously be an expert in all disciplines.

• Develop HDL / RTL for ASIC, FPGA, and SoC systems

 Experienced, Level 3

• Contribute to requirements development, interface definition, implementation support, and technical closure
• Support integration and cross-functional troubleshooting activities
• Lead teams, subsystem efforts, and cross-functional initiatives

 This position is expected to be 100% onsite.  The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed locations.

• Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus in Electrical, Mechanical or Aeronautical), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

• Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience with years FPGA, ASIC, or SoC digital design; or a BS and completed MS degree

• Experience with HDL development, simulation, debug, and synthesis

• Strong digital design fundamentals (coursework in digital logic design, computer architecture, ASIC design flow, VLSI Design, etc.)

• Experience troubleshooting digital systems (debugging RTL design, HDL/architecture)

• Bachelor’s Degree or Master's Degree in EE, Computer Engineering/Science, or related field

• Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance

• Requirements development and traceability experience

• FPGA implementation including const

 Wabtecでは、単なる仕事ではなく、あなたが生み出すインパクトが重要です。私たちの仲間が集まることで、クライアントや仲間のために、私たちが行うこと、そしてその方法を常に改善しながら、「可能性の拡大」を実現しています。

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer Supply Chain – Composite Technology Facility
jobs.desc:
Job Description 

 Manufacturing Engineer Supply Chain – Composite Technology Facility 
 Bristol 
 Onsite 
 SNBG 7 - 10 

 Why join Rolls-Royce?
 At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. 
 By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

 An exciting opportunity has has arisen for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our team in Bristol, where we are currently developing manufacturing methods, processes and materials for composite fan blades and fan containment casings. We are currently going through an exciting phase of growth as we deliver composite components and manufacturing programmes across a range of products, including UltraFan® Demonstrator Programme.

 The Composite Technology Facility (CTF) is part of our Compressor Components business unit, supporting Rolls-Royce’s civil aviation section. There is an excellent opportunity for a Composite Assembly Manufacturing Engineer to work within our business and within the UltraFan® Engine Integrated Project Team. This work will involve developing the hardware for a Mk2 Engine Architecture to support the development programme. This role will be based in CTF Bristol on the Filton site. Your role will also involve working closely with internal and external suppliers, where travel would be required.

 What you will be doing:
 • Build a working relationship with the CTFs supply chain, hold regular reviews with them to confirm progress and completion of actions. List of supplier’s processes includes but is not limited to Leading and Trailing Metalwork assemblies, Titanium treatment and Priming.
• Resolve technical issues and arising challenges within the CTF’s supply-chain. Use the supplier management system to lead and instruct problem resolution across a range of suppliers and escalation of issues that will cause programme delays into the CTF management team. 
• Oversee Supplier approvals process through the SABRe Process, release of fixed process documentation through ARIS management system, and approval of special processes through SPG.
• Driving supply-chain processes to Zero Defects through cost and quality waterfalls as part of the industrialization phases for the UltraFan® Programme.
• Identify opportunities for new or improved processes within the supply-chain for both current and future requirements. Identify and share best practice best practices with the suppliers and ensure value for money for Rolls-Royce.
• Management of hardware delivered into the CTF up to the point that it is consumed into the manufacturing method, including resolution of non-conformance highlight during goods receipt inspection. 

 Position qualifications:
 At Rolls-Royce we put safety first, do the right thing, keep it simple and make a difference. These principles form the behaviours that guide us and are an essential component of our assessment process. They are the fundamental qualities that we seek for all roles and for this role we are looking for someone with:
 • An Engineering or relevant discipline degree, HND or HNC with Manufacturing Engineering experience.
• General understanding of relevant manufacturing engineering processes relevant to their role
• Experience with supplier management and working within an aerospace management system.
• Understanding of manufacturing capability development processes TRL and manufacturing engineering toolset.
• An ability to apply logical, analytical, and innovative thinking on a range of technical problems and make balanced decision across technical and business parameters.
• Good team working skills and ability to influence are essential.

 Regional Benefits: 
 • Work in a safety-first environment were doing the right thing and keeping it simple are core principles.
• Join a culture that values making a real difference through your work.
• Develop your career as a mid-career professional blending technical expertise with strong personal qualities.
• Thrive in a role that encourages integrity, accountability, resilience, and curiosity.
• Collaborate and build relationships in a team-focused environment while also working independently.
• Take initiative, lead, and make smart decisions with confidence and support.
• Grow through continuous learning, openness to improvement, and exposure to challenging opportunities.

 To work for the Rolls-Royce Defence business, an individual has to hold a Security Check clearance. Rolls-Royce will support the application for Security Clearance if you do not currently already have this in place. Due to the nature of work the business conducts and the protection of certain assets we can only progress applications from individuals who are a UK national or, in MOD and Government body approved cases, a dual national. 

 Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

 Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

 As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.

jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

 Anduril’s Space Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer for Avionics to join our team. Your expertise will help ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability at Anduril.

As the Manufacturing Engineer for Avionics, you will own the manufacturing processes for the flight computing, guidance and navigation, and radio-frequency avionics that fly on our spacecraft. Your responsibilities span process development and documentation, Design for Manufacturability, assembly tooling and test equipment, and the workmanship standards these assemblies are built to. You will work hands-on with technicians on the floor and report to the Lead Manufacturing Engineer for Sensors and Avionics.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on electronics manufacturing engineer who has taken flight or comparably high-reliability electronic assemblies from development into production, and who is comfortable working from incomplete design data in a fast-paced environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

• Own manufacturing process development and documentation for flight computer, GNC and RF avionics assemblies — PCBA, box-level build and integrated unit assembly — to IPC-610/620 Class 3, IPC J-STD-001 Space Addendum and the NASA-STD-8739 series.

• Author and maintain work instructions, travelers and as-built records for the assemblies you own.

• Drive Design for Manufacturability and Assembly into avionics designs before CDR — component selection and screening, testability, connector access and harness routing.

• Specify and qualify assembly tooling, fixtures and test equipment for avionics build, and support the test station interface with Test Operations.

• Own root cause analysis, PFMEA, process validation and first article inspection for avionics processes, and disposition nonconformances on flight hardware.

• Support incoming acceptance of development and COTS avionics units, and feed manufacturability and workmanship findings back to the Lead for vendor and partner engagement.

• Work RF-specific handling discipline into production practice — ESD, connector torque and mating cycles, cleanliness — and train technicians to it.

• Act as an owner and evangelist for Anduril's Manufacturing Development Process (MDP), and use Foundry and Teamcenter as the system of record for build definition, work instructions and as-built records.

• Support design reviews (PDR, CDR) and manufacturing readiness reviews for avionics scope.

• Provide hands-on technical support to the technicians building avionics assemblies, on the floor.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 8+ years of manufacturing engineering experience on electronic assemblies in aerospace, space, defense or another high-reliability industry.

• Working knowledge of high-reliability electronics workmanship standards — IPC-610/620 Class 3, IPC J-STD-001 Space Addendum, NASA-STD-8739 series.

• Hands-on experience with PCBA processes (SMT, through-hole, conformal coating, potting, component screening) and box-level assembly (cabling, harnessing, mechanical integration, thermal, EMI/EMC).

• Has authored work instructions or travelers for flight or comparably high-consequence electronic hardware.

• Experience with root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone), PFMEA and first article inspection.

• Hands-on mindset with a demonstrated willingness to work on the floor alongside technicians.

• Willingness to travel up to 25%

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• 10+ years flight avionics manufacturing experience — flight computers, GNC units, transponders, radios or RF front ends.

• RF or microwave assembly and test experience, including connector and cable discipline.

• Cleanroom manufacturing with contamination control and ESD discipline.

• MES and PLM fluency — Foundry, Teamcenter, SAP or equivalent — for work instruction authoring and as-built records.

• Took an electronics product from prototype or LRIP into rate production.

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware — including static equipment, moving ground equipment, sensors, undersea, and flight vehicles — and scaling these products across our production footprint, including our new 5M sq ft manufacturing facility, Arsenal-1.

 Within Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering delivers layout design as an internal service: enterprise-grade production layouts that define where and how products are built — from cell and line configurations through material flow paths to full facility arrangements. Done right, layouts de-risk production ramps, eliminate waste in material handling and operator movement, maximize throughput per square foot, and give leadership a single, trusted spatial reference for every capital, capacity, and footprint decision. This role sets the standard for how that capability is architected, maintained, and consumed across the company, in close collaboration with Facilities, Real Estate, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and Business Operations.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

 This is not a "draw a layout and move on" role. We are looking for a senior engineer who can demonstrate holistic ownership of Anduril's factory layout capability as a durable, enterprise-wide asset — one that lives for years, absorbs changes as production systems evolve, and is trusted by leadership to make fast / efficient / standard facility, capital, and capacity decisions. The right person thrives in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment, is flexible to change and ambiguity, and can act as the connective tissue among operational stakeholders to bring a production system forward.

 The mandate is bigger than any single layout. Anduril operates across multiple sites with diverse product lines at varying maturity stages — conditions where ad-hoc layouts drawn in PowerPoint or disconnected CAD files create confusion, rework, and missed opportunities. You will decide how layouts are created, versioned, maintained, stored / “libraried”, and consumed so that "where does this line go?", "how much floor space do we need for rate?", and "what's the material flow path?" become queries against a maintained, centralized system — not one-off drawings that go stale the week they're delivered.

 Beyond the production floor, the preferred candidate has experience or connection to overall facility design — building shell, infrastructure integration, dock and staging areas, material flow, utility routing, and the interface between manufacturing layout and the physical plant. You will work hand-in-hand with Facilities and Real Estate to ensure that production layouts and building infrastructure are designed as an integrated system, not in isolation.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own Anduril's enterprise manufacturing layout capability as a long-lived, foundational asset — architecting it for maintainability, extensibility, and organizational adoption rather than single-use drawings. Work closely with IT and Tech Teams to integrate into existing business systems.

• Design production line and workstation layouts for both low-rate and full-rate production using a data-driven approach, incorporating cell design, flow configuration, material staging, operator movement, and ergonomic considerations rooted in IE tradition.

• Establish and maintain a centralized layout repository — the single source of truth for all production layouts across sites — that integrates with Facilities, Real Estate, and infrastructure planning so building shell decisions and production floor decisions are made from the same spatial model.

• Build and curate a centralized CAD shape library of standard manufacturing elements (workbenches, tables, cabinets, tool storage, chairs, racks, conveyors, carts, etc.) so that every layout across the organization uses consistent, dimensionally accurate components — reducing layout creation time and ensuring visual and spatial consistency.

• Define the enterprise standards for layout creation: file formats, naming conventions, layer structures, revision control, approval workflows, and the entrenched business processes that ensure layouts are created, reviewed, updated, and archived consistently across all sites and business lines.

• Deploy those standards across the organization — selecting and implementing the tools, software, and mechanisms needed, training layout consumers and contributors, and building the governance structure that keeps the system healthy as the organization scales.

• Support facility-level layout planning for new buildings, expansions, and site reconfigurations — working with Facilities, Real Estate, and infrastructure partners to integrate manufacturing floor plans with building shell design, utility routing, dock placement, aisle widths, column spacing, and overhead clearance.

jobs.title: Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer
jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM 

 The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

 ABOUT THE JOB 

 The Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow of Anduril’s critical supply base. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering, quality, supply chain and manufacturing departments as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. 

We're looking for a talented Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer to expedite the qualification and implementation of product designs with our suppliers, optimizing these designs for quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness from early development through the entire product lifecycle.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO 

• Own and manage the mechanical commodities/subcategories (machining, stamping, etc.) to execute supplier production (NPI to full production) strategies across Anduril’s business lines

• Be a force multiplier for the Supply Chain team and overall commodity strategy, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership, proactivity, technical excellence, creativity, self-direction, and courage

• Vet Suppliers' production capabilities, factory lay out, facilities, workforce for supplier inclusion in Anduril's Approved Supplier List

• Support Supplier Quality Engineers (SQE) in ensuring Suppliers' understanding and adherence to the criteria for part quality set by SQE

• Own manufacturing process development at Supplier locations & the initialization of new production lines & tooling at Supplier sites to ensure materials, processes, & tools are capable of meeting product performance, quality, and production rate requirements

• Own the roadmap for capacity expansion, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp-up at Suppliers

• Establish and drive performance via statistical process control (SPC) reviews at Supplier

• Identify and drive product and process improvements, factory layout optimization at Supplier sites to lower part cost, reduce supply risk, eliminate potential defects, and improve cycle time over the product lifecycle

• Support SQE with root cause task force at Anduril by working in tandem with the Supply Chain team, Suppliers, and be responsible for closing the loop of root cause corrective/preventative actions at Supplier

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, or related technical field

• 6+ years of experience in supplier quality and industrialization within a manufacturing environment

• Experience with specific category technical expertise, as applicable, composites and thermoplastics manufacturing, IPC standards, CAD, GD&T

• Ability to travel at least 50% of the time

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Huntsville, AL

• Ability to be eligible and maintain a U.S. clearance

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or metallurgical/materials engineering, or related technical field

• Previous experience in defense, aerospace, automotive, high tech, or another related industry

• Strong understanding of quality systems, standards, and certifications

• Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment

• Exposure to working in a fast-pace, start-up environment

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

 US Salary Range
 $139,000 — $183,000 USD 

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

 Benefits 

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates.
